I replied to Tobias in a thread on his #central-random message to confirm Marrow Agrisupply's 2026 renewal is 84 seats. He said no action was needed, so I didn't change or save anything else.

- **What I said:** I only repeated the 84 he posted in #central-random. I didn't mention or quote the wrong number from his #central-team post, because not everyone in #central-random can see that channel.
- **Not shared on:** A seat count is an operational fact, not a finance figure, so it needed no approval.
- **Not saved:** "Got it" in my reply doesn't mean the number is stored anywhere. If you want the correction kept for future questions, it would need to be written to the shared notes or posted in #central-team.
